Flyer302997
Tokyo, Japan11 contributions

Sea crab (steamed) is hard to peel, but it tastes strong and delicious
Dec 2025 • Family
The paper menu is arranged on the shelf at the back of the first floor, so I borrowed it and it was helpful to understand the Japanese menu. There is also Japanese on the mobile menu, but the paper menu is easy to see because you can see the list.
We used it for dinner twice during our stay.
The first time we asked the hotel to make a reservation, and they reserved a seat by the sea. After the first checkout, we booked another dinner ourselves. I asked for a seat by the sea then as well. It is recommended to reserve a seat by the sea 30 minutes before sunset.
Crab soup is a small bowl, enough for one person. The kids loved it, so I ordered both.
Pork porridge is abundant in bowls, and there are enough for four. The kids liked it, so I ordered it both times.
The crab fried rice is crispy but slightly oxidized, but the kids liked it and ordered it both times.
Grilled scallops with cheese have two small scallops on top, cheese on top and mayonnaise inside, which tastes a little junky.
The frozen carrots and green peas in the recommended croquettes are not good, and when you take them off they look a little crab.
For the first time, I ordered steamed sea crab. Two or three cups a kilo at market value, 5,000 yen. It took me an hour to peel it off because it was so small, but it tasted thicker and tasted better than the frozen crab I eat in Japan and was very satisfied.
Grilled lobster cheese costs 7,000 yen a kilo at market value. He was very muscular.
Order ice-free fruit juice for kids. The oranges on the glass were cut in an elaborate way.
English is spoken, and the interior is clean and atmospheric.
If you don't have a reservation, you'll have to wait about 15 minutes, so we recommend making a reservation.
